title: Ashita, Watashi wa Dareka no Kanojo
titleRomaji: Ashita, Watashi wa Dareka no Kanojo
titleNative: 明日、私は誰かのカノジョ
synonyms: Asu, Watashi wa Dareka no Kanojo
Tomorrow, I Will be Someone's Girlfriend
synopsis: "One time a week, I will be the girlfriend of [someone]." A bitter love story depicting the realities of love between female college students who earn money on behalf of her and men attracted by her. The first volume is a young office worker who rents the protagonist snow as a fake girlfriend, and draws a distorted love pattern of sota and snow. A substitute girl who plays the customer and the woman of their ideals to the end... Is the distance between two people's mind really close? Notes: - Winner of the 68th Shogakukan Manga Award in the Shōjo Category - Nominated for the Tsugimanga 2020 Award in the Web Manga Category.

title: Blue Ursus
synopsis: Ready to fight! Only bad girls would go to Gokumon Girls' High School. A big girl, Amaki Seina, over 180cm tall, enrolls in this rough school full of delinquents. With her extraordinary physique, she uses professional wrestling moves to defeat the delinquents one after another! What's more, she uploads clips of the fights to a video site...? What is the "personal goal" she is pursuing by picking fights with delinquents?! (Source: Manga One, translated)

title: Kochira, Shuumatsu Teitai Iinkai
titleNative: こちら、終末停滞委員会。
synopsis: Kotoyorozu Kotoha, a boy with an underground past as a former mafia underling, had given up on youth. However, his life changes completely after meeting certain girls. With massive guns, they fight against mysterious beings threatening to destroy humanity! This is their school life — full of chaos, action, and unexpected twists. Behind the facade of the world lies a wild and outrageous youth like no other! A mega-serialized story packed with sci-fi, romance, action, and more — let the fun begin!

title: They Are Still Being Shaken This Morning
titleEnglish: They Are Still Being Shaken This Morning
synopsis: Every morning at 6:58, commuters hurry onto the train at Sakuranomiya Station. For the past few months, a tentative romance has been brewing between two students from different schools. The young man is easily flustered, always stealing a glance at the young woman, but never making a move—much to the disappointment of the other passengers, who have been cheering them on in secret. Will this budding love story ever blossom? (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Wo Xiangyao!!
synopsis: Zhong Xiangyao contracted a strange illness. This is a coming-of-age story about “losing control,” as well as a fable about “honesty.” When everyone has learned to hide their true thoughts and live behind masks, is the one who cannot pretend actually sick or the only one who remains lucid? Throughout his three years of high school, Zhong Xiangyao wanted only one thing: to be an ordinary person. That is exactly what “I want!!” (Source: Bilibili, translated)
